title: Weighted composition operators and classification of weighted Hardy spaces
summary: In this paper, we shed light on basic questions such as: What is the "right" underlying set on which a function space lives, and is this set uniquely determined? What are the appropriate morphisms to classify function spaces? When does a weighted composition operator induce an isomorphism, and when does it induce an isometric isomorphism? We first formulate suitable notions for domains of reflexive functional Banach spaces and study the corresponding notions of isomorphism between Hilbert function spaces.
